newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end up as locals players buy bargains.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end up as locals players buy bargains.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed up Monday in moderate volume as local players continued the buying trend of the last couple of weeks, brokers said.
The market will be closed Tuesday and Wednesday due to New Year's Day celebrations, but is expected to rise again on reopening Thursday, they added.
Monday, the General Index rose 1.23 percent to 1,423.0 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index edged up 1.26 percent to 2,013.1 points, according to preliminary figures.
